## Purpose and Entry Points
SolveSpace is a native C++ parametric 2D/3D CAD system. CMake defines the build graph and produces GUI and CLI variants. Platform-specific launch paths separate application initialization from UI hosting: `src/platform/entrygui.cpp`, `src/platform/entrycli.cpp`, and shared application state in `src/solvespace.cpp`.

## Core Model and Parametric Pipeline
The central model represents entities, parameters, requests, constraints, groups, and styles. User-created requests expand into geometric entities; constraints relate their parameters; groups organize modeling operations and generated geometry. Core definitions and transformations are concentrated in `src/solvespace.h`, `src/request.cpp`, `src/entity.cpp`, `src/constraint.cpp`, and `src/group.cpp`.

## Constraint Solving
Constraint equations are generated from the model and solved to update parameter values, making this the primary computational boundary between editable design intent and evaluated geometry. `src/constrainteq.cpp` constructs equations, `src/system.cpp` implements solver/system handling, and `src/param.h` defines the parameter-facing model. Expressions used for entered dimensions and derived values live in `src/expr.cpp`.

## Geometry Generation and Solid Modeling
Solved sketches and groups generate curves, polygons, meshes, and solids. Mesh/polygon operations support downstream display, analysis, export, and boolean modeling. Relevant stages are `src/generate.cpp`, `src/groupmesh.cpp`, `src/mesh.cpp`, and the surface/solid subsystem under `src/srf/`, especially `src/srf/boolean.cpp`, `src/srf/shell.cpp`, and `src/srf/triangulate.cpp`.

## Interaction, UI, and History
The application layer maps mouse/keyboard actions and toolbar/text UI commands into model edits, regenerates/solves the model, and redraws the active view. Undo/redo preserves model-edit history. Main interaction and presentation components are `src/graphicswin.cpp`, `src/mouse.cpp`, `src/modify.cpp`, `src/textwin.cpp`, `src/toolbar.cpp`, and `src/undoredo.cpp`. GUI adapters are selected per platform: GTK, Qt, Win32, macOS, HTML, or no-GUI implementations under `src/platform/`.

## Rendering and Resources
Rendering consumes generated entities/meshes plus view state and selects 2D Cairo or OpenGL backends. The abstraction and implementations are `src/render/render.h`, `src/render/render.cpp`, `src/render/rendercairo.cpp`, `src/render/rendergl1.cpp`, and `src/render/rendergl3.cpp`; GLSL assets are in `res/shaders/`. Fonts, icons, localization, and platform bundles are compiled/deployed from `res/`.

## File, Import/Export, and External API Boundaries
Persistent `.slvs` documents and linked inputs enter through `src/file.cpp`; external CAD/mesh formats use dedicated importers (`src/importdxf.cpp`, `src/importidf.cpp`, `src/importmesh.cpp`) and exporters (`src/export.cpp`, `src/exportstep.cpp`, `src/exportvector.cpp`). The reusable solver C API is exposed by `include/slvs.h` and implemented under `src/slvs/`; language bindings include `python/slvs/` and the WebAssembly-facing `src/slvs/jslib.cpp`.

## Runtimes, Dependencies, and Delivery
Primary targets are desktop GUI/CLI binaries on Linux, Windows, macOS, and OpenBSD; Emscripten builds an experimental browser UI through `src/platform/guihtml.cpp` and `src/platform/html/`. CMake orchestrates native and vendored dependencies through `CMakeLists.txt` and `src/CMakeLists.txt`. Material libraries include OpenGL/Cairo, GTKmm or Qt6, FreeType/fontconfig/Pango, zlib/libpng, Eigen, and optional SpaceNavigator support; vendored sources are under `extlib/`. CI and release packaging cover native, web, Snap, and Flatpak via `.github/workflows/cd.yml`, `pkg/snap/snap/snapcraft.yaml`, and `pkg/flatpak/com.solvespace.SolveSpace.json`.
